text: The cost basis of investors that bought the top still caps BTC's upside. Holders who bought 1 to 2 years ago sold heavily as $BTC rallied toward $88k, where the 6 to 12 month group breaks even. Price stalled just under it. That selling has since slowed considerably.

$BTC has bounced off the ETF cost basis. Price spent most of this year below that level, and the May rally stalled right under it. It has now held twice as support around $81.5k. Below it, the next major level is the True Market Mean at $77.5k.
